kb:
MILLIAN LABAU PLANTATION 5 ESTATE (MLP 5), United Malacca Berhad (UMB), Sabah. Fact pack from PA Report 1/2026 (Planting Advisor En. Adnan Bin Mustafa, visit 5-6 May 2026, previous visit 29-30 Oct 2025, review period May 2025 to April 2026 = FY2025/26, 12 months) and Agronomy Report 2/2026 (Junior Agronomist En. Alison Bin Janari, Senior Agronomist Mr Chong Kuan Ming; visit 29 July 2026, previous visit Agronomy 1/2026 in February 2026; manuring programmes FY2026/27 and FY2027/28). Estate Manager Mr Benjinus Robin (Benjinus Bin Robin, on estate since 01.11.2024). Senior Manager Mr Celestine Sipilis (Agro: Celestine Bin Siplis). Financial year runs May to April.

AREA (PA Table 1, as of April 2026): title 1,947.00 ha. Mature 1,102.51 ha (87% of planted): 2012A 225.45 ha (108 SPH), 2013A 408.72 ha (101), 2012B 230.69 ha (79), 2013B 237.65 ha (69). Immature 177.02 ha: 2024B 64.13 ha and 2025B 112.89 ha. Total planted 1,279.53 ha (66% of title), up from 1,166.64 ha because of the 112.89 ha 2025B rehabilitation planting. Roads 128.61 ha, un-plantable 479.66 ha, buildings/others 59.20 ha. PA text 2.3 says immature rose from 64.13 to 117.02 ha and unplantable fell to 592.55 ha (table shows 177.02 and 479.66). Rehab planned for 64.00 ha in FY2026/27 (PA 2.5). Division A 634.17 ha and Division B 645.53 ha (PA 6.1.2). Division A = fields A01-A21 (2012A, 2013A); Division B = B22-B38 (2012B, 2013B) plus all immature.
AREA (Agro 2/2026 Tables 1-4, as of July 2026): mature 1,102.51 ha; Table 1 shows immature (new planting) 117.02 ha and total planted 1,219.53 ha (65%), but Table 2 lists immature 177.02 ha (2024B 64.13 ha in 11 sub-blocks B22-B to B34-B; 2025B/25C 112.89 ha in B29C-B36C) and a grand total of 1,279.53 ha. Unplanted 667.47 ha (roads 128.62, steep/hilly/abandoned 99.13, forest 362.14, riparian 53.67, river 16.17, buildings 5.16, open 2.16, pond 0.42); gross 1,887 ha. Replanting programme 236.18 ha: 104.59 ha FY2025/26 and 131.57 ha FY2026/27; land preparation started on 112.89 ha (81.08 + 31.81 ha); 23.51 ha of the FY2025/26 area not started (machinery) and carried to FY2026/27. Palm stand (Table 4): 12A 24,754 palms, 110 SPH (up 2% from 24,320 after rehab census); 12B 18,120, 79 SPH; 13A 41,311, 101; 13B 16,299, 69; 24B 7,514, 117; 25C planting not yet in the stand; total 107,998 palms, 85 SPH. PR25C has not yet been redesignated PR26.

STAFF (PA section 3): Estate Manager, Sr Assistant Manager Syril Philip, Assistant Manager Pius Bin Jali, 3 field conductors (one joined Nov 2025), chief clerk, 2 general clerks, storekeeper, mechanic. Adequate; PA recommends 1 more field conductor because terrain is steep and remote.

LABOUR (PA Table 4, April 2026): 131 workers vs 139 required (-8); 1 more than last visit's 130; 1 worker per 10 ha, adequate. Harvesters 56 vs 73 required (-17), 5 fewer than 61 at last visit, 1 per 20 ha mature; PA says 10 more are needed (hilly, steep, some areas lack terraces). No infield collectors. Internal transport 4/4, weeding mature 14 vs 20, manuring 11 vs 15 (1 per 116 ha, adequate), immature OP 5, weeding immature 4, mandore 4 vs 5, security 2 vs 3, pruners 4, general workers 10. 18 sprayers (1 per 71 ha incl. immature), also deployed to manuring.

GENERAL CHARGES (PA Table 5 and Appendix 1, FY2025/26): RM2,219,159.53 = RM1,843.61/ha on 1,203.71 ha weighted planted (budget RM2,438,382 = RM1,918.13/ha on 1,271.23 ha), 9% below budget. Management and supervision RM851,222.57 (RM707.17/ha vs 733.22); labour and amenities RM470,838.96 (RM391.16 vs 456.49, -14%); office and related RM875,904 (RM727.67 vs 703.83, +3%); other RM21,194 (RM17.61 vs 24.59). Items: staff salary RM534,189 (budget 595,561), water/electricity RM432,674 (459,194), labour paid leave RM150,329 (98,070, +53% because holiday pay uses average earnings), staff bonus RM122,718, labour recruitment RM113,062 (227,049), staff EPF RM105,528 (95,460, +11%, EPF on FY2024/25 bonus), cess/rate/rent RM103,918, labour welfare RM92,077, security RM85,911, insurance RM64,824, transport and travelling RM50,446 (22,791, 221%), donation/sponsor/entertainment RM22,255 vs RM1,800 (CSR site levelling at Kg Pulutan and Kg Saup RM5,747.49, RM10,000 condolence fund to wife of late employee Nardilius, more visitors), licence/permits RM3,938 (Genset A licence renewal), weighbridge RM18,479 (14,422; MLP 1 cost share), MSPO RM19,225 (43,060).

UPKEEP AND CULTIVATION (PA Table 6, FY2025/26, RM/ha mature 1,102.51 ha): total RM2,744,809 = RM2,489.60/ha vs budget RM2,812,772 = RM2,551.24/ha; RM161.18/t vs RM137.71/t. Upkeep supervision RM32.15/ha (37.52); weeding RM231,906 = RM210.34 (229.99); manuring RM974,446 = RM883.84 (1,442.46, 61% of budget due to delayed programme); pests and diseases RM22.54 (16.11; beneficial plants, firebreak, firefighting, security patrol in Div B); census and thinning RM4.38 (21.53); drains RM19.05 (45.13); roads and bridges RM1,124,291 = RM1,019.76 (612.31, +66%; new road by excavator and crusher-run patching by Regional Office Road Team); soil/water conservation RM107,019 = RM97.07 (30.79; 50,805 m and 442 hours of terrace harvesting paths in Div B); boundaries RM13.28 (8.62; surveyor RM6,350); pruning RM197,178 = RM178.84 (102.98; corrective pruning in rehab area); tools RM8.33 (3.81).

WEEDING (PA): circle and path spraying 2 rounds programmed = 2,205.02 ha; done 1,608.26 ha, printed 59% / 1.10 rounds (2012A 100%, 2013A 92%, 2012B 50%, 2013B 44%). Selective (blanket inter-row) 3 rounds = 3,307.53 ha; done 1,224.95 ha, 37%, 1.0 round. Delays from heavy rain Nov/Dec 2025 to Mar 2026 and sprayers diverted to manuring. Circle: Inter pump 150 ml glyphosate per 10 L; 2.40 ha/man-day at RM28/ha = RM67.20/day (optimum 4-5 ha). Mist blower 150 ml triclopyr (Kenlon) + 40 g metsulfuron (Emly) per 10 L; 2.50 ha/man-day, RM70/day. Inter-rows still dominated by Clidemia, Eupatorium, Hedyotis, Melastoma, Asystasia, VOP, Stenochlaena, bracken, sedges; Lalang, Pennisetum and Giant Paspalum being sprayed; soft grasses and Nephrolepis establishing, expected to dominate within a year.
WEEDING (Agro 2/2026): FY2025/26 full year (Table 11): Div A blanket spray 655.04 of 634.17 ha (103%), circle 1,168.33 of 1,268.34 (92%), VOPs 0 of 634.17, woody poisoning 405.05 of 60 (675%), selective weeding 603.39 of 951.86 (63%); Div B blanket 569.91 of 468.34 (122%), circle 439.48 of 936.68 (47%), VOPs 208.04 of 468.34 (44%), woodies 368.94 of 50 (738%), selective weeding 334.48 of 702.51 (48%). Circle spraying in Div B delayed by labour and machinery shortages and access. FY2026/27 as of July 2026 (Table 12): circle round 1 12A 35%, 13A 7%, 12B 0% (not started), 13B 66%, total 24%; inter-row round 1 12A 53%, 13A 45%, 12B 35%, 13B 57%, total 47%; woody poisoning 13B 16% (total 4%). Ground conditions not satisfactory, especially Div B (grasses, Clidemia, Asystasia; poor in B24, B25, B26, B28); uneven spraying in B24, A01, A03 (over-spraying and incomplete kill on hills); VOPs increasing in palm circles of rehab areas.

MANURING (PA Table 9, FY2025/26 to April 2026): required 1,071.17 mt, delivered 1,070.89 mt, applied 715.84 mt (67%), balance printed 361.05 mt (delivered minus applied is 355.05; the Oct-25 RP row balance 23.90 should be 17.90). Mature Mix B rounds: May 100%, Jun 100%, Aug 86%, Sep 56%, Nov 70%, Jan 57%, Feb 47%, Apr 8%; RP Jul 73%, Oct 81%. Immature rounds mostly 0-37%. Delay due to heavy rain Nov-Mar and worker shortage; buckets used on steep terrain; 20 bags/man-day at RM2.50/bag = RM50/day.
MANURING (Agro 2/2026, as at July 2026): FY2025/26 programme (Table 5) mature Mix B 691.2 of 846.08 mt applied (82%), RP 158.2 of 167.24 (95%), total 849.4 of 1,013.32 mt (84%); delivered column printed 7,814.65 mt Mix B (apparently a typo); immature RP 3.73 of 19.81 (19%), CPD 1.6 of 38.77 (4%), Mix B 0.4 of 4.86 (8%), Fujicoat 2.02 of 7.85 (26%), total 7.75 of 71.29 mt (11%; replanting delays). One Apr 2026 round still outstanding in Division B (12B, 13B) in July; agreed to cancel it and reconcile the stock against FY2026/27. FY2026/27 (Table 6, programme due to July 2026): mature Mix B 78.75 of 272.85 mt (29%; 124 mt delivered), kieserite 0 of 30.73, total 78.75 of 303.58 mt (26%); immature CPD, Fujicoat, BRP 0 of 49.65 mt. Causes: carry-over from FY2025/26, fertiliser delivery issues, machinery (100-120 bags per trip), worker output under 20 bags/day. Application in P13B-24 acceptable; avoid terrace lips and weedy circles. Div B store under renovation, bags kept outside under canvas. Old NK Mix and CCM65 stocks (quantity unknown) to be used: NK Mix 1.5 kg/palm in Block 38, CCM65 1.5 kg/palm on Block 25 supply palms.

FERTILISER PROGRAMME (Agro 2/2026 appendices, grams per palm): FY2026/27 (Appendix 1, same as Agro 1/2026): 2012A Mix B 2000 g Jun, Sep, Jan, Mar, kieserite 1500 g Jul, RP 1500 g Nov. 2012B Mix B 2000 g May, Sep, Jan, Apr, 1500 g Aug (fertiliser not named), kieserite 1000 g Jul (B27, B32-B34), RP 1500 g Dec; B29 8000 g sub-soil. 2013A Mix B 2000 g Jun, Sep, Jan, Apr, kieserite 1000 g Jul (A03, A04, A14), RP 1500 g Nov; A03 8000 g sub-soil. 2013B Mix B 2000 g May, Aug, Nov, Feb, kieserite 1000 g Jun (B22, B38), RP 1500 g Oct. 2024B CPD 1200 g May, RP 1700 g Jul, CPD 1200 g Aug, 1500 g Nov and Feb. 2025C (99.38 ha, 11,926 palms): CPD 800 g and RP 1500 g in the 9th month after planting (Feb and Mar 2027 columns). 2026D (131.57 ha, 15,788 palms): CRF 600 g and RP 500 g, with 0.80 printed beside them. FY2027/28 (Appendix 2, new): 2012A Mix B 2000 g Jun, Sep, Dec, Mar, RP 1500 g Oct; 2012B Mix B 2000 g May, Aug, Nov, Feb, kieserite 1000 g Jul (B32, B34), RP 1500 g Oct, B29 8000 g sub-soil, B36 CRF 3000 g (sub-surface, 3 holes) with RP and Feb Mix B; 2013A Mix B 2000 g Jun, Sep, Dec, Mar, kieserite 1000 g Jul (A03, A04), RP 1500 g Oct, A03 8000 g sub-soil; 2013B Mix B 2000 g May, Aug, Nov, Feb, kieserite 1000 g Jul (B22, B38), RP 1500 g Oct; 2024B Mix B 1500 g May, RP 1500 g Aug, Mix B 1500 g Sep, 1750 g Dec and Mar; 2025C CPD 800 g Jul, RP 1500 g Aug, CPD 900 g Oct, 1000 g Jan and Apr. CRF trial 3 kg/palm in field 36 (poor growth). Mix B 9.45:0:24:3.7:0.48; CPD 14:13:9:2.5; RP 30% P2O5; kieserite 27% MgO.

PALM CONDITION, PEST AND DISEASE: PA - no serious rat damage, baiting unnecessary, census every 3 months; no bagworm; Ganoderma negligible. Agro 2/2026 - leaf analysis (Table 8, by sub-block, date not printed): N, P, K, Mg and B mostly high/normal; calcium marginally low in every sub-block. Palms acceptable except hilly hanging-terrace and rehab areas: small bunches, thin trunks and low vigour persist in P13B-22, P12B-32, P12B-34, P13B-38, P13A-03, P13A-04; Mg deficiency in hilly areas; etiolation in ravines (B36), census and selective thinning ongoing; access roads in hills improved (commended). Pests under control; localised rat damage on bunches, not significant.

PRUNING: PA Table 10 - 2,243.41 ha done vs 2,205.02 ha programme (100%) by April 2026; progressive pruning at RM1.00/palm/year paid in two instalments, PA recommends quarterly. Agro 2/2026 - FY2025/26 corrective pruning (Table 9) 240.95 of 246.39 ha (98%): 12A 100%, 13A 100%, 12B 101%, 13B 87% (rest carried forward: worker shortage, access). FY2026/27 as of August 2026 (Table 10): progressive 13,438 of 100,484 palms (13%; 12A 10%, 13A 10%, 12B 19%, 13B 20%; payment-based); corrective 2,252 of 713 palms (316%; programme underestimated). Pruning quality good; over-pruning in B35, B36, B37.

ROADS, DRAINS (PA): no grading or crusher-run surfacing all year (insufficient crusher run, weather; surfacing contractors terminated); Road Team patching on piece rate. Road maintenance 10,457.98 chains at RM53.70/chain (budget 48.28); bridge excavator 401 hrs RM83.33/hr; culvert 87 hrs RM84.23/hr (budget RM85). Agricultural roads unsurfaced, soft and slippery; quarry is on the estate. Drains: backhoe 98 hrs at RM48/hr.

HARVESTING (PA section 7): 56 harvesters in 4 groups, wheelbarrow evacuation, 4 mini-crawlers. Intervals 7-16 days in April 2026 (Table 13). Output (Table 14) at RM55/t: 2012A 1.43 t/man-day RM78.65; 2013A 1.38, RM75.90; 2012B 1.52, RM83.60; second 2012B row 1.67, RM91.85; basic wage RM65.39. Agro 2/2026 Table 7 intervals: P12A and P13A mostly 10-16 days in FY2025/26 and 10-13 days May-Aug 2026; P12B and P13B more variable in May-Nov 2025, at times 15-31 days (May, Jun, Aug, Nov 2025), up to 21 days in Apr 2026, 11-18 days May-Aug 2026. Crop recovery and evacuation acceptable, few overripe or unfresh bunches; unripe bunches at the ramp a concern; incomplete loose fruit collection and oxidised loose fruit in rehab areas.

HARVEST AND COLLECTION COST (PA Table 15, FY2025/26): RM2,256,852.04 = RM132.53/t vs RM131.84 budget. Supervision 4.79 (4.97), harvesting own FFB RM977,419.88 = 57.40 (59.14), infield loading 4.57 (4.15), ramp 3.87 (3.29), internal transport RM398,965.01 = 23.43 (18.23), tools 0.59 (0.86); sub-total 94.65 (90.64); external transport RM645,040.03 = 37.88 (41.20).

CROP (PA Table 16, FY2025/26 May 2025-Apr 2026): FFB 17,029.48 t vs 20,425.00 t budget (-17%); last year printed 14,018.28 t (Agro 2/2025 gives that for FY2023/24 and 13,557.26 t for FY2024/25). Yield 15.45 t/ha vs 18.53 budget (-3.08) and 12.40 last year. CPO 3,429.98 t (budget 4,162.61; last year 2,868.59), OER 20.14% (20.38; 19.99), kernel 747.36 t, KER 4.39%, CPO yield 3.11 t/ha (3.78; 2.46).
YIELD BY FIELD (Agro 2/2026): FY2025/26 full year at Period 12 (Table 16): 12A 19.90 t/ha (FY2024/25 15.72, +27%), 12B 9.88 (8.15, +21%), 13A 19.16 (15.16, +26%), 13B 10.93 (9.05, +21%); mean 15.45 (12.40, +25%). FY2026/27 May-Jul 2026, Period 3 (Table 17) vs same period FY2025/26: 12A 2.13 (5.43, -61%), 12B 1.16 (3.02, -62%), 13A 2.05 (5.33, -62%), 13B 1.45 (3.29, -56%); mean 1.74 (4.41, -61%); average 0.58 t/ha a month, below expectations although neighbouring estates also had a non-seasonal crop dip. Limiting factors: delayed manuring, poor weed control, machinery and worker constraints, difficult access, incomplete rehab recovery.

COST OF PRODUCTION (PA Table 17, FY2025/26): general charges RM2,027,832 = RM119.08/t (budget 103.54); upkeep RM161.18 (137.71); harvest and collection RM132.53 (131.84); total RM7,029,493.04 = RM412.78/t vs RM373.09/t budget, 11% over, mainly low crop. Text 9.1 and 13.11 say per hectare in error. GC in Table 17 is less than the Table 5 total RM2,219,159.53 (allocation basis not stated).

VEHICLES (PA Table 18): management vehicles in line; farm tractors over budget from repairs, e.g. SYL8512 RM57,729 vs RM2,500 budget (RM23.78/hr), JVT2613 RM33.44/hr vs 24.46, JWP4809 RM40.09 vs 31.07, SS3807P RM31.22 vs 18.53.

IMMATURE (PA 11-12): 2024B 64.13 ha, 7,514 palms, 117 SPH, no EFB applied, cost from start RM533,724.52 = RM8,323/ha. 2025B 112.89 ha: cost from start RM544,971.27 = RM4,827/ha vs RM1,057,691 budget; PA expected planting complete June 2026. Agro 2/2026: 24B SPH still 117 (sub-blocks 109-133), no more plantable gaps (steep); palms healthy, weaker on steep slopes; weeding delayed (Clidemia, Asystasia, grasses), Mucuna starting to cover palms; some narrow terraces collapsing - plant vetiver on edges; wild-animal precautions near jungle. 25C (Tables 14-15): felling and stacking 112.89 ha; new road 266.83 chains, road repair 1,292.99, new terrace 2,090.64 chains, terrace area 51.72 ha; planted 4,658 palms on 49.50 ha (B29 201, B30 2,828, B31 808, B32 821; 94 SPH), B33, B35, B36 not yet planted; Mucuna and cover crop planted; seedlings from Paitan nursery good; no EFB, polythene circle mulch recommended.

RAINFALL (Agro 2/2026 Appendix 3, FY May-Apr): FY15/16 1,637 mm/110 days; FY16/17 2,377/146; FY17/18 2,659/169; FY18/19 2,058/129; FY19/20 2,582/139; FY20/21 2,441/183; FY21/22 2,430/174; FY22/23 2,581/171; FY23/24 1,936/149; FY24/25 3,254/187; FY25/26 2,402/155; FY26/27 May-Aug 2026 1,005/58 (May 322, Jun 246, Jul 341, Aug 96).

PA CONCLUSIONS: labour adequate but 10 more harvesters; GC 9% under; weeding and manuring delayed (consult PARAS agronomist); road grading and crusher-run surfacing essential; progressive pruning good, pay quarterly; harvesting below 16 days; performance improved overall. Agro 2/2026 conclusions: manuring still a concern; FY2025/26 programme not completed, stocks reconciled into FY2026/27; FY2027/28 programme drafted; yield down 61% in May-Jul 2026; ground vegetation below expectation; 24B SPH 117; 25C planting started.

DATA CAVEATS: Agro 2/2026 Table 1 (planted 1,219.53 ha, immature 117.02) disagrees with its Table 2 and the PA (1,279.53, 177.02); PA and Agro differ on some weeding and manuring figures; Agro Table 5 Mix B delivered figure looks mistyped. PA last-year FFB 14,018.28 t matches Agro 2/2025's FY2023/24; Agro 2/2025 gives FY2024/25 as 13,557.26 t (12.40 t/ha) and FY2022/23 14,509.85 t.
